NestForge garden ambience
Source: Gentle breeze and birds singing — ezwa, 18 April 2007.
https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Gentle_breeze_and_birds_singing.ogg
Public domain, released by the recordist through PDSounds.
Contains blackcap/chaffinch birdsong and natural breeze.
Adaptation: crossfaded loop, wind-rumble filtering, loudness adjustment, MP3 encoding.
No generative voice or speech is used.
